limitations: 显示器包含窗口过滤器只允许自建窗口，裁剪区域与窗口一致，采集前核对实际窗口归属及过滤器名单。
完整图像与 idle 通知分别计数，idle 保留上一张完整图像，按接收时间记录实际观察内容。
此项是仅含自建窗口的显示器过滤器证据，完整桌面与真实会议远端仍需验收。

checks.name: single registered window during live capture
display filter includes only the owned window with an exact crop
three ordered policy acknowledgements with local window visible
complete images have valid pixels and ordered media timestamps
every SDK output records its complete image or retained idle image
baseline-before has continuous observed output and valid controls
sharing-none has continuous observed output and valid controls
baseline-after has continuous observed output and valid controls
protection was active before capture with continuous initial output
live comparison has an interpretable protected outcome
